• We will cover Sanskrit for Class 10th students.
  • This is a Live Interactive Course, and the complete syllabus will be covered by October. However, you will have access to the course until your board exams..
  • Live Doubt-Solving Sessions will be conducted as part of this course.
  • Class Recordings will be available immediately after the live sessions on the Master Sahab app.
  • Class Notes will be provided in PDF format for each session on the Master Sahab app.
  • Frequent Tests will be conducted to assess your progress after completing specific portions of the syllabus.
  • The entire course will remain accessible to you until your board exams in 2027.
  • Classes start in OCTOBER 2026.
  • This course price is for complete batch (not monthly)
  • This batch is non-refundable and non-transferable
